snapshot: Fixed simulation; all relative times refer to this snapshot, not the current clock.

changes: Reduced database connection pool from 50 to 10 connections

runbook.title: Checkout latency and database connection contention
checks: Compare p95 latency and error rate with their baselines and the deployment timeline.
Inspect pool utilization, connection wait time and database connection timeout logs.
Check slow queries and database capacity to distinguish pool contention from a database bottleneck.
runbook.possible_mitigation: If connection pool contention is confirmed, ask the service owner to review restoring the previous pool configuration or rolling back version 1.8.2.
runbook.verification: After an approved mitigation, check that connection waits, p95 latency and error rate return toward baseline.

runbook.title: Catalog service health checks
checks: Compare current latency and error rate with their baselines.
Check database connection waits and the deployment timeline before proposing an incident.
runbook.possible_mitigation: If metrics remain near baseline, report that this snapshot shows no evidence of an incident and continue monitoring.
runbook.verification: Escalate only when new evidence indicates sustained degradation.
